summary_en: Period-end dividend raised to 13.0 yen/share from 9.0 yen/share (44% hike). Net income forecast raised to 1,089 million yen (36% increase). Payout ratio not disclosed.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast (Upward Revision) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending May 2026
translation_en_brief: TONE Co., Ltd. announced on 30 June 2026 a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 31 May 2026. The period-end dividend (year-end) has been increased to 13.0 yen per share from the previously announced 9.0 yen per share, representing a 4.0 yen or 44% increase. This dividend increase accompanies an upward revision to the full-year net income forecast, which was raised to 1,089 million yen (from 800 million yen), a 36% increase. The company cited strong performance in high-value-added products and company-wide cost reduction efforts as drivers of improved profitability, despite a slight decline in sales. The company's dividend policy balances ongoing capital strengthening with stable, earnings-linked distributions. No payout ratio or number of shares outstanding figures were disclosed in the revision notice.
